schinese.description: Win the first Independent 500 in the year 1911 with 300+ AI.

schinese.description: Starting in 1929, as an Italian company, produce only sports and super cars. And win 50 racing championships.

schinese.description: As a Japanese company, with 300+ AI, sell 1 million vehicles. Use a Wankel engine in a vehicle, and have the best selling roadster in the world.

schinese.description: As a Paris, France company, with 300+ AI on Base City or Classic Map, sell 100,000 vehicles and Outsource or License engines to 10 different companies by 1930. Be the largest manufacturer by total sales numbers before 1909.

schinese.description: By 1909, sell 15,000 vehicles and create a 200 HP vehicle.

schinese.description: As a German company on Base City or Classic Map, win a German Airforce contract by 1918.

schinese.description: As a British company with 300+ AI, do not produce a vehicle that weighs more than 3000lbs. Also win 50 racing championships.
